summary: GetItems records count as found only when success == 1 and visible is true; apps Steam hides from anonymous requests return ErrAppHidden and are left out of demo lookups, so their demo state is unknown (null) rather than false.
reason: Corrects code merged in #2244. GetItems answers apps hidden from anonymous requests (age or region gate, e.g. Elden Ring 1245690) with success:15 and visible:false; the merged client skipped only success == 0, so such apps counted as found with an empty name and has_demo:false. Live, every real record checked (200 catalog, 25 search, and all GetItems results) carries success:1 and visible:true, so the stricter rule drops nothing real.
validated_outcome: Offline tests with the real Elden Ring response as fixture pass and fail again when the old success != 0 rule is restored. Live: `steam app 1245690` exits 3 with "is hidden from anonymous store requests ... demo state are unknown"; a hidden app on a --with-demos row carries no has_demo.
